verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents reserved instances that give discounts of up to 50% for pre-paying GPU time, and any on-demand instance can be converted to reserved at any time. That directly matches the story's committed-use discount for sustained capacity. Missing for 10: details on commitment terms and durations, evidence that reservations can be managed via CLI/API, clarity on whether reservation guarantees capacity on marketplace hosts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
